meta.topic: Direct Case Pilot A: Intrapartum Fetal Assessment

stem.en: Review the unfolding maternal-fetal record and answer the case-study items.
stem.zh: 查看逐步展开的母胎病历，并回答病例题。

correct.en: This case requires comparing the fetal heart rate with its earlier baseline, integrating a new intrapartum risk factor with maternal observations and labor progress, selecting cause-directed supportive care, and using the response to fetal scalp stimulation plus the subsequent tracing to determine the safest ongoing plan.
correct.zh: 本病例要求将当前胎心率与先前基线比较，把新出现的产时风险因素与母体观察和产程进展整合起来，选择针对可能原因的支持措施，并根据胎儿头皮刺激后的反应及随后胎心图来判断最安全的后续计划。

testTakingStrategy.en: Do not interpret one fetal-monitor feature in isolation. Compare the tracing with the prior review, then add maternal status, uterine activity, labor progress, and new intrapartum risks before deciding whether observation, senior review, or expedited birth is supported.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 不要孤立解读单一胎心监护特征。先与上一次评估比较，再结合母体状况、宫缩活动、产程进展及新出现的产时风险因素，判断应继续观察、请高级人员评估，还是加快分娩。

glossary.defZh: 同时连续记录胎心率和宫缩活动的监测方法。
在胎心率稳定的时间段内，排除加速和减速后估计的平均胎心率。
胎儿排入羊水中的首次粪便；产程中出现时需结合完整临床情况进行风险评估。
在阴道检查时刺激胎儿头皮并观察胎心率是否出现加速，以辅助评估胎儿状况。

meta.source: NICE NG229, Fetal monitoring in labour, recommendations 1.2.3, 1.3.5, 1.3.7–1.3.12, 1.4.1–1.4.4, 1.4.10, 1.4.15, 1.4.31–1.4.33, 1.5.2, 1.5.4–1.5.6, 1.5.11–1.5.12, and 1.6.1–1.6.2, https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/ng229/chapter/Recommendations

title.en: Unfolding case: changing fetal assessment during labor induction
title.zh: 展开式病例：引产过程中变化的胎儿评估

summary.en: A term client is undergoing oxytocin induction with continuous maternal-fetal monitoring.
summary.zh: 一名足月产妇正在接受缩宫素引产，并进行持续母胎监护。

content.en: G1P0 at 40 weeks 3 days. Singleton fetus in cephalic presentation. The client is admitted for a scheduled induction. Oxytocin is infusing according to the unit induction protocol, and continuous CTG is in use. The client has no fever, hypertension, diabetes, vaginal bleeding, or reported decrease in fetal movement.
content.zh: G1P0，孕40周3天。单胎，头位。产妇因计划性引产入院。正在按病区引产流程输注缩宫素，并使用持续胎心宫缩监护。产妇无发热、高血压、糖尿病、阴道流血，也未报告胎动减少。

content.en:
Maternal: T 36.9°C (98.4°F), HR 82/min, BP 118/72 mm Hg, RR 16/min, SpO2 98% on room air. No constant abdominal pain or vaginal bleeding.
Labor: 3 contractions in 10 minutes, each 55 to 65 seconds, with a soft resting tone. Cervix 5 cm/80%/−1. Membranes intact.
CTG: baseline fetal heart rate 125/min, variability 10 to 20 beats/min, 2 accelerations in 20 minutes, and no decelerations.
content.zh:
母体：体温36.9°C（98.4°F），心率82次/分，血压118/72 mm Hg，呼吸16次/分，室内空气SpO2 98%。无持续性腹痛或阴道流血。
产程：10分钟内3次宫缩，每次55至65秒，宫缩间歇子宫张力柔软。宫颈扩张5 cm、消退80%、先露−1。胎膜完整。
胎心宫缩监护：胎心率基线125次/分，变异度10至20次/分，20分钟内有2次加速，无减速。

content.en:
At 1015, the membranes rupture spontaneously. A moderate amount of meconium-stained fluid is noted.
Maternal: T 37.0°C (98.6°F), HR 88/min, BP 116/70 mm Hg, RR 17/min, SpO2 98% on room air. No constant abdominal pain or vaginal bleeding.
Labor: 4 contractions in 10 minutes, each 60 to 70 seconds, with a soft resting tone. Cervix 6 cm/90%/−1.
CTG: baseline fetal heart rate 145/min for 10 minutes, variability 8 to 15 beats/min, accelerations present, and no decelerations.
content.zh:
10:15胎膜自然破裂，可见中等量胎粪污染羊水。
母体：体温37.0°C（98.6°F），心率88次/分，血压116/70 mm Hg，呼吸17次/分，室内空气SpO2 98%。无持续性腹痛或阴道流血。
产程：10分钟内4次宫缩，每次60至70秒，宫缩间歇子宫张力柔软。宫颈扩张6 cm、消退90%、先露−1。
胎心宫缩监护：胎心率基线持续10分钟为145次/分，变异度8至15次/分，有加速，无减速。

title.en: 1100 reassessment after the agreed care plan
title.zh: 11:00 按既定护理计划干预后的重新评估

content.en: The client changes from a semi-reclined position to the left lateral position. During a vaginal examination, digital fetal scalp stimulation produces an acceleration of 18 beats/min lasting 20 seconds.
content.zh: 产妇由半卧位改为左侧卧位。阴道检查时进行胎儿头皮刺激，胎心率加速18次/分并持续20秒。

content.en:
Maternal: T 37.0°C (98.6°F), HR 84/min, BP 118/74 mm Hg, SpO2 98% on room air.
Labor: 3 contractions in 10 minutes, each 55 to 65 seconds, with a soft resting tone. Cervix 7 cm/90%/0. Meconium-stained fluid remains present.
CTG for the next 20 minutes: baseline fetal heart rate 135/min, variability 10 to 15 beats/min, 2 accelerations, and no decelerations.
content.zh:
母体：体温37.0°C（98.6°F），心率84次/分，血压118/74 mm Hg，室内空气SpO2 98%。
产程：10分钟内3次宫缩，每次55至65秒，宫缩间歇子宫张力柔软。宫颈扩张7 cm、消退90%、先露0。胎粪污染羊水仍存在。
随后20分钟胎心宫缩监护：胎心率基线135次/分，变异度10至15次/分，有2次加速，无减速。

stem.en: Which statement best describes the 0900 CTG?
stem.zh: 哪项陈述最准确地描述09:00胎心图？

options.en: The CTG is normal: all four assessed features are white, and the current risk of fetal acidosis is low.
options.zh: 胎心图正常：评估的四项特征均为白色，目前胎儿酸中毒风险较低。

options.en: The CTG is suspicious because oxytocin use is itself an amber CTG feature.
options.zh: 胎心图可疑，因为使用缩宫素本身就是黄色胎心图特征。

options.en: The CTG is pathological because 3 contractions in 10 minutes is a red contraction feature.
options.zh: 胎心图病理性，因为10分钟内3次宫缩属于红色宫缩特征。

options.en: The CTG cannot be categorized because no decelerations are present.
options.zh: 胎心图无法分类，因为没有出现减速。

correct.en: The contraction frequency is fewer than 5 in 10 minutes, the baseline is stable at 125/min, variability is 10 to 20 beats/min, and there are no decelerations. These are white features, so the CTG is normal. Accelerations further support current fetal wellbeing. Oxytocin remains an intrapartum risk factor for the broader care plan, but it is not itself an amber CTG feature.
correct.zh: 10分钟内宫缩少于5次，胎心率基线稳定在125次/分，变异度为10至20次/分，且无减速。这些均属于白色特征，因此胎心图正常。加速进一步支持胎儿目前状况良好。缩宫素仍是整体护理计划中的产时风险因素，但它本身不是黄色胎心图特征。

byChoice.en: Correct. Contractions, baseline, variability, and decelerations are all white features at 0900.
byChoice.zh: 正确。09:00时宫缩、基线、变异度和减速四项均为白色特征。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. Oxytocin use affects the monitoring plan but is not one of the four CTG features used to classify the trace.
byChoice.zh: 错误。使用缩宫素会影响监护计划，但不属于用于胎心图分类的四项特征。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. Fewer than 5 contractions in 10 minutes is a white contraction feature, not a red feature.
byChoice.zh: 错误。10分钟内少于5次宫缩属于白色宫缩特征，而不是红色特征。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. The absence of decelerations is a white deceleration feature and supports classification as normal.
byChoice.zh: 错误。无减速属于白色减速特征，并支持将胎心图归为正常。

testTakingStrategy.en: Classify the four CTG features first. Keep intrapartum risk factors such as oxytocin use in the whole-picture assessment without incorrectly turning them into tracing features.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 先分类胎心图的四项特征。将使用缩宫素等产时风险因素纳入完整临床评估，但不要误把它们当作胎心图特征。

glossary.defZh: 胎心率基线周围的细小波动，反映自主神经系统活动。
胎心率短暂上升，通常是胎儿状况良好的表现。

meta.source: NICE NG229, Fetal monitoring in labour, recommendations 1.3.5, 1.3.8 (oxytocin as an intrapartum risk factor), 1.4.1–1.4.4, 1.4.12, 1.4.15, 1.4.18, 1.4.24, 1.4.30–1.4.32, and 1.5.4, https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/ng229/chapter/Recommendations

stem.en: Compare the 1030 CTG with the 0900 record and complete the interpretation.
stem.zh: 将10:30胎心图与09:00病历比较，并完成判断。

clozeStem.en: The 1030 CTG is {{1}} because the principal category-changing feature is {{2}}.
clozeStem.zh: 10:30胎心图属于{{1}}，因为改变分类的主要特征是{{2}}。

options.en: a 20-beat/min rise in baseline fetal heart rate since the earlier review
options.zh: 与先前评估相比胎心率基线上升20次/分

options.en: 4 contractions in 10 minutes with a soft resting tone
options.zh: 10分钟内4次宫缩且宫缩间歇子宫张力柔软

options.en: the presence of accelerations with variability of 8 to 15 beats/min
options.zh: 有加速且变异度为8至15次/分

correct.en: The baseline increased from 125/min to 145/min, a rise of 20 beats/min since the earlier review. NICE categorizes that change as an amber baseline feature. Because the other CTG features remain white, the overall CTG is suspicious rather than normal or pathological. Meconium is an additional intrapartum risk factor that must be considered separately in the management decision.
correct.zh: 胎心率基线由125次/分升至145次/分，与先前评估相比上升20次/分。NICE将这种变化归为胎心率基线的黄色特征。由于其他胎心图特征仍为白色，整体胎心图属于可疑，而不是正常或病理性。胎粪是另一个产时风险因素，制定处理计划时必须另行纳入考虑。

byChoice.en: One amber CTG feature with no red feature makes the overall CTG suspicious.
byChoice.zh: 存在一个黄色胎心图特征且无红色特征时，整体胎心图归为可疑。

byChoice.en: The category-changing feature is the 20-beat/min baseline rise; the current absolute rate remains within 110 to 160/min.
byChoice.zh: 改变分类的特征是基线上升20次/分；当前绝对胎心率仍在110至160次/分范围内。

testTakingStrategy.en: Compare with the prior baseline before judging the current absolute number. A value can remain within 110 to 160/min yet become concerning because of its change over time.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 判断当前绝对数值前，先与先前基线比较。即使数值仍在110至160次/分范围内，也可能因随时间变化而令人担忧。

glossary.defZh: 提示关注程度增加、需要纳入整体胎心图分类的监护特征。
四项胎心图特征中有一项为黄色、且无红色特征的监护结果。

meta.source: NICE NG229, Fetal monitoring in labour, recommendations 1.4.1–1.4.3, 1.4.10, 1.4.15, 1.4.31–1.4.33, and 1.5.2, https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/ng229/chapter/Recommendations

stem.en: While the team completes the whole-picture review, which proposed order should the nurse question?
stem.zh: 医疗团队进行完整临床评估期间，护士应质疑哪项拟议医嘱？

options.en: Apply maternal facial oxygen solely because the CTG has changed, although SpO2 is 98% on room air.
options.zh: 尽管室内空气SpO2为98%，仍仅因胎心图变化而给予母体面罩吸氧。

options.en: Compare the current CTG with the earlier tracing and document the change in baseline fetal heart rate.
options.zh: 将当前胎心图与先前监护结果比较，并记录胎心率基线的变化。

options.en: Repeat maternal observations and review contraction frequency and labor progress.
options.zh: 重复母体生命体征，并评估宫缩频率和产程进展。

options.en: Explain the change and the need for additional review to the client and support the client's participation in decisions.
options.zh: 向产妇解释病情变化及需要进一步评估的原因，并支持产妇参与决策。

correct.en: Maternal facial oxygen should not be used as a routine conservative measure for a fetal-heart-rate concern when the client is not hypoxic; NICE notes that it may harm the baby. Comparing the trace over time, repeating the whole maternal-labor assessment, documenting the change, and involving the client are appropriate.
correct.zh: 产妇没有低氧时，不应把母体面罩吸氧作为胎心率异常的常规保守措施；NICE指出这种做法可能伤害胎儿。比较胎心图随时间的变化、重复完整的母体和产程评估、记录变化并让产妇参与决策均属适当。

byChoice.en: Correct. Routine maternal facial oxygen is not recommended when maternal hypoxia is absent.
byChoice.zh: 正确。母体无低氧时，不建议常规给予面罩吸氧。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. Comparing with the earlier tracing is necessary because the 20-beat/min baseline rise is only apparent over time.
byChoice.zh: 错误。必须与先前胎心图比较，因为基线上升20次/分只有通过时间趋势才能发现。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. Maternal observations, contraction frequency, and labor progress are required parts of the whole-picture review.
byChoice.zh: 错误。母体生命体征、宫缩频率和产程进展都是完整临床评估的必要组成部分。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. The client should be informed when additional review is sought and supported in decisions about care.
byChoice.zh: 错误。需要进一步评估时，应告知产妇，并支持其参与护理决策。

testTakingStrategy.en: Question interventions that do not match the physiologic problem. A fetal-monitor change does not create a maternal oxygen indication when maternal oxygenation is normal.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 应质疑与生理问题不匹配的干预。胎心监护发生变化，并不会在母体氧合正常时自动产生吸氧指征。

glossary.defZh: 通过面罩向产妇供氧；只有存在母体低氧等母体指征时才应使用。
把胎心图变化与母体生命体征、宫缩、产程和风险因素一起评估。

meta.source: NICE NG229, Fetal monitoring in labour, recommendations 1.1.4, 1.2.3, 1.4.1–1.4.3, 1.4.10, 1.5.2–1.5.3, and 1.5.12 (do not offer maternal facial oxygen absent a maternal indication), https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/ng229/chapter/Recommendations

stem.en: For each 1100 finding, indicate how it contributes to evaluation of the current plan.
stem.zh: 针对11:00的每项发现，判断其对当前计划评估的意义。

rows.en: Fetal scalp stimulation produced an 18-beat/min acceleration lasting 20 seconds.
rows.zh: 胎儿头皮刺激后出现胎心率加速18次/分并持续20秒。

rows.en: For the next 20 minutes, the baseline was 135/min with variability 10 to 15 beats/min, accelerations, and no decelerations.
rows.zh: 随后20分钟胎心率基线为135次/分，变异度10至15次/分，有加速，无减速。

rows.en: Maternal temperature, blood pressure, heart rate, and oxygen saturation remain stable.
rows.zh: 母体体温、血压、心率及血氧饱和度保持稳定。

correct.en: An acceleration after fetal scalp stimulation followed by sustained normalization of the baseline, variability, accelerations, and decelerations supports current fetal recovery. Stable maternal observations support continued stability. Meconium does not resolve with tracing improvement and remains an intrapartum risk factor requiring ongoing CTG and whole-picture reassessment.
correct.zh: 胎儿头皮刺激后出现加速，随后胎心率基线、变异度、加速和减速持续恢复正常，支持胎儿目前正在恢复。母体生命体征稳定也支持当前状况稳定。胎心图改善并不会消除胎粪这一因素；胎粪仍是需要持续监护和完整临床重新评估的产时风险。

byChoice.en: An acceleration after digital fetal scalp stimulation is a reassuring response when it is followed by sustained CTG improvement.
byChoice.zh: 数字化胎儿头皮刺激后出现加速，并伴随后持续胎心图改善，是令人放心的反应。

byChoice.en: The sustained 20-minute pattern has a stable baseline, normal variability, accelerations, and no decelerations.
byChoice.zh: 持续20分钟的胎心模式显示基线稳定、变异度正常、有加速且无减速。

byChoice.en: Meconium remains a separate intrapartum risk factor even when the CTG improves.
byChoice.zh: 即使胎心图改善，胎粪仍是一个独立的产时风险因素。

byChoice.en: Stable maternal observations reduce concern for maternal hypoxia, hypotension, or sepsis as a current driver of fetal compromise.
byChoice.zh: 母体生命体征稳定，降低了母体低氧、低血压或脓毒症目前驱动胎儿受损的可能性。

testTakingStrategy.en: Evaluate both response and residual risk. A reassuring response can change urgency without erasing the intrapartum factor that triggered closer surveillance.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 同时评估干预反应和残余风险。令人放心的反应可以改变紧急程度，但不会消除促使加强监护的产时风险因素。

glossary.defZh: 改善在随后一段观察时间内继续存在，而不是短暂变化。
干预后仍存在、需要继续观察或处理的危险因素。

meta.source: NICE NG229, Fetal monitoring in labour, recommendations 1.3.5, 1.3.10–1.3.12, 1.4.4, 1.4.10, 1.4.30–1.4.33, and 1.6.1 (acceleration plus sustained CTG improvement after fetal scalp stimulation supports continued monitoring), https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/ng229/chapter/Recommendations

stem.en: After reviewing all data through 1100, which ongoing plan is best supported?
stem.zh: 查看截至11:00的全部资料后，哪项后续计划最有依据？

options.en: Defer expedited birth at this time; continue CTG and close whole-picture observation under a documented reassessment plan.
options.zh: 目前暂不加快分娩；在有记录的重新评估计划下继续胎心宫缩监护和完整临床情况的密切观察。

options.en: Discontinue CTG now and return to intermittent auscultation.
options.zh: 现在停止胎心宫缩监护并改回间歇听诊。

options.en: Prepare for immediate expedited birth now.
options.zh: 现在准备立即加快分娩。

options.en: Begin continuous maternal facial oxygen to prevent another baseline rise.
options.zh: 开始持续给予母体面罩吸氧，以防胎心率基线再次升高。

correct.en: The acceleration after fetal scalp stimulation and the sustained 20-minute CTG improvement support deferring expedited birth at this time. Meconium and oxytocin induction remain intrapartum considerations, so continued CTG, documented whole-picture reassessment, and a clear threshold for renewed escalation are safer than returning to intermittent monitoring.
correct.zh: 胎儿头皮刺激后出现加速，且随后20分钟胎心图持续改善，支持目前暂不加快分娩。胎粪和缩宫素引产仍是产时需考虑的因素，因此继续胎心宫缩监护、记录完整临床重新评估，并明确再次升级处理的阈值，比改回间歇监护更安全。

byChoice.en: Correct. The post-stimulation response and sustained tracing improvement lower immediate urgency, while residual intrapartum risks require continued surveillance.
byChoice.zh: 正确。刺激后的反应和胎心图持续改善降低了眼前紧急程度，而残余产时风险仍要求继续监护。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. The tracing improved, but meconium and oxytocin use remain reasons to continue CTG and repeated risk assessment.
byChoice.zh: 错误。胎心图虽改善，但胎粪和使用缩宫素仍是继续监护和反复风险评估的理由。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. Meconium requires full risk assessment and continued monitoring; by itself it does not override the sustained reassuring response and mandate immediate birth.
byChoice.zh: 错误。胎粪要求完整风险评估和继续监护；单凭胎粪不能推翻持续令人放心的反应并强制立即分娩。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. Maternal facial oxygen is not recommended for fetal resuscitation when the client is not hypoxic.
byChoice.zh: 错误。产妇无低氧时，不建议使用母体面罩吸氧进行胎儿复苏。

testTakingStrategy.en: The closing decision should reconcile both directions of the case: improvement lowers immediate urgency, while an unresolved risk factor prevents premature de-escalation.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 结尾决策要同时整合病例的两个方向：改善降低了眼前紧急程度，而未解决的风险因素又阻止过早降低监护等级。

glossary.defZh: 因母体或胎儿风险而加快完成阴道分娩或剖宫产。
同时综合母体状态、胎儿监护、宫缩、产程进展和风险因素。

meta.source: NICE NG229, Fetal monitoring in labour, recommendations 1.4.10, 1.5.2, 1.5.4–1.5.6, and 1.6.1 (after an acceleration and sustained CTG improvement following fetal scalp stimulation, continue fetal-heart-rate and clinical-picture monitoring), https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/ng229/chapter/Recommendations
